merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.desc: Combine multiple PDFs into one unified document.

split.title: Split PDF
split.desc: Separate one page or a whole set for easy conversion into independent PDF files.

organize.title: Organize PDF
organize.desc: Sort, add and delete PDF pages. Drag and drop the page thumbnails to update their order.

rotate.title: Rotate PDF
rotate.desc: Rotate your PDFs the way you need them. You can even rotate multiple PDFs at once!

crop.title: Crop PDF
crop.desc: Trim PDF margins, change PDF page size, and crop PDF documents.

flatten.title: Flatten PDF
flatten.desc: Make your PDF read-only. Prevent editing of forms and annotations.

extract.title: Extract Pages
extract.desc: Extract pages from your PDF document or save each page as a separate PDF.

convert_pdf.title: Convert PDF
convert_pdf.desc: Convert PDF to Word, Excel, PowerPoint and more.

pdf_to_jpg.title: PDF to JPG
pdf_to_jpg.desc: Convert each PDF page into a JPG image.

jpg_to_pdf.title: JPG to PDF
jpg_to_pdf.desc: Convert JPG images to PDF in seconds.

ai_summarize.title: AI Summarize
ai_summarize.desc: Summarize your PDF documents using AI.

video_to_pdf.title: Video to PDF
video_to_pdf.desc: Extract frames from a video and save as PDF.
